# gemma-qat-bench — llms.txt
# Fast orientation map for AI coding agents and developers.

## Project

Gemma QAT Bench is a Python package and CLI for reproducible performance comparison
of QAT and non-QAT Gemma GGUF models using llama.cpp / llama-server.

Primary concerns:

- build llama.cpp with CPU or CUDA support
- download/resolve GGUF model files from Hugging Face
- start and stop llama-server safely
- send OpenAI-compatible chat requests
- capture timing/token/VRAM metrics
- aggregate repeated runs
- compare QAT against a non-QAT baseline
- render console, Markdown, and JSON reports

The project measures runtime performance and memory usage; it is not an accuracy or
model-quality benchmark.


## Agent framework

- `AGENTS.md` — repository-wide engineering contract and task/skill routing
- `.github/copilot-instructions.md` — concise always-on GitHub Copilot instructions
- `.github/instructions/*.instructions.md` — automatic path-specific instructions for
  source code, tests, documentation, and configuration
- `.github/agents/` — active V1.5 Planner/Plan Critic custom-agent profiles; V2.1 does not yet add production coding-role profiles
- `.github/skills/` — native reusable Copilot skills for specialized engineering tasks
- `.context/prompts/*.prompt.md` — reusable task templates
- `.context/AGENT-ROLES.md` — authoritative V1/V1.5 and V2.1 orchestration role, gate, state, and runtime-capability contract
- `.context/handoff-TEMPLATE.md` — tracked task-scoped orchestration handoff/state/artifact template
- `.context/world-state-TEMPLATE.md` — template for optional gitignored working state
- `.context/README.md` — how to use local world state and reusable task prompts

The roles are intentionally different:

- `AGENTS.md` defines how engineering work should be performed.
- `llms.txt` provides a fast map of the repository.
- `.github/instructions/` applies focused rules based on the files being worked on.
- `.github/skills/` provides specialized task expertise.
- `.context/prompts/` provides reusable task framing.
- `.context/world-state.md`, when present, stores local current-session/project state.


## Repository map

```text
gemma-qat-bench/
├── AGENTS.md
├── llms.txt
├── src/
│   └── gemma_qat_bench/
│       ├── __init__.py       public package exports/version
│       ├── __main__.py       python -m gemma_qat_bench

│       ├── config.py         frozen validated config + TOML loading
│       ├── build.py          llama.cpp clone/CMake build + CUDA detection
│       ├── models.py         Hugging Face GGUF download/resolution
│       ├── server.py         llama-server process lifecycle + health checks
│       ├── client.py         /health + /v1/chat/completions HTTP client
│       ├── vram.py           nvidia-smi memory sampling
│       ├── metrics.py        per-run + aggregate metrics
